audit_scope: Round-5 reviewer-safe manuscript audit: source/proof/asset freshness plus oracle-versus-fitted, FIT/CAL, formal edge cases, recovery, literature, Figure 1 package locality, and negative-evidence boundaries. It is not a scientific rerun, full raw-data provenance reconstruction, or proof assistant.
canonical_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 every listed file's raw bytes; sort relative POSIX paths bytewise (LC_ALL=C); concatenate UTF-8 lines '<file-sha256><two spaces><relative-path><LF>'; SHA-256 those bytes. Exclude this manifest and generated LaTeX auxiliaries.
residual_blocker: The local audit checks supplied derived-manifest replay, source boundaries, citations, and assets. It cannot reconstruct the derived manifest from omitted raw parquet, rerun omitted secondary datasets/runners, establish ordered online behavior, gold correctness, operational cost, target-population containment, a K-independent executable Appendix E(g) repair, or an efficiency comparison to the direct WoR-CS majority stopper.
